_comment: Lime-green theme for REMOTE cloud-API sessions. Applied via per-session settings overlay — never written to user's persistent ~/.claude/settings.json.
_contract: Theme accent #7CFC00 (lime). SHIPPED 2026-09-21 via a CUSTOM THEME FILE at ~/.claude/themes/free-lime.json (shape {name,base,overrides}) selected by the ordinary `theme` setting in the per-session overlay. The earlier verdict that this was an unconfirmable upstream limitation probed a `themes` SETTINGS MAP — the wrong mechanism. Verified against CLI 2.1.278: loader path userConfigDir("themes",[slug]), a [theme] watcher for hot reload, and `claude --help` listing "custom themes". generate-remote-settings.py is the single source of truth for both halves.
